## Où j'en suis
analytics-staging runs PostgreSQL 17.2 since 14:20 UTC on Nov 17, after a blue/green switchover with 41 s of refused writes; pg_partman was upgraded 4.7.4 → 5.1.0 and dbt's events models (14) pass on 17.2. PR #57 is open with commits 7e3c9d4 and b0f18a2, prod is prepared but behind pg17_enabled=false, and the runbook now carries the logical_replication + reboot step. (source: ses-pg-3, src-pr57, src-slack-infra)

- [en-cours] PR #57 open: staging on 17.2, prod prepared but disabled (pg17_enabled=false) and still undated (source: src-pr57, ses-pg-3)
- [prochaine-étape] prod cutover in two windows: first set rds.logical_replication=1 and reboot (2–3 min downtime), then the blue/green deployment (source: s3-09, s3-10)
- [prochaine-étape] pick the prod window once staging has run a full week on 17 (sign-off earliest Nov 24), outside the dbt lock 01:00–03:30 UTC (source: s3-09, s3-10)
- [essai-raté] terraform init -upgrade pulled AWS provider v6 and the plan showed 37 unrelated changes (S3 ACLs, aws_eip.vpc) (source: s1-01)
- [essai-raté] first staging apply failed: blue/green requires rds.logical_replication=1, a static parameter needing a reboot (source: s3-04)
- [question] prod cutover date — waiting on Maya's sign-off (source: src-linear-kes298, s3-09)
- [décision] AWS provider pinned to 5.82, no v6 in this PR (source: s1-02)
- [décision] no prod date until Maya signs off, apply_immediately stays false (source: s1-04)
- [décision] staging reboot approved; prod runbook step 0 is logical_replication=1 + reboot before the blue/green (source: s3-05, s3-09)
